app.name: SignBridge
app.tagline: Learn Nepali Sign Language with an animated tutor

eval.title: Evaluation
eval.subtitle: Signer-independent model metrics and native-signer avatar intelligibility.
eval.intelSubtitle: The metric that actually matters — rated by native NSL signers (1–5).
eval.ratePrompt: How intelligible is this sign? (1 = unclear, 5 = perfectly clear)
eval.note: Model accuracy here is on SYNTHETIC data — it validates the harness, not real NSL recognition. Intelligibility ratings must be collected from deaf NSL signers to be meaningful.

interpret.title: Interpreter
interpret.subtitle: Two-way, constrained-domain interpretation between NSL and English / Nepali.
interpret.pickHint: Add recognized signs to the sequence, then interpret them to text (and speak it).
interpret.empty: No signs yet — tap signs below.
interpret.scopeNote: Constrained-domain interim: speech in/out uses the browser's Web Speech API (Nepali support varies), and Sign→Text assembles recognized signs. Text is always available as a fallback. A fine-tuned Nepali ASR/TTS and continuous recognition are future work.

tutor.title: Learn NSL
tutor.subtitle: Spaced-repetition lessons — the avatar signs, you rate how well you knew it.
tutor.ready: Ready for a lesson? Each session mixes due reviews with new signs.
tutor.sessionDone: Lesson complete! Your reviews are scheduled.
tutor.rate: How well did you know this sign?
tutor.error: Could not reach the tutor. Is the backend running?

produce_page.title: Text to sign
produce_page.subtitle: Type in English or Nepali and watch the avatar sign it in NSL.
produce_page.procedural: Procedural placeholder motion derived from sign phonology — awaiting authored Blender clips with ARKit blendshapes.
produce_page.error: Could not build the signing plan. Is the backend running?

home.title: Learn Nepali Sign Language with an animated tutor
home.subtitle: A bilingual tutor and interpreter for NSL — an avatar that signs, on-device recognition, and spaced-repetition lessons in English and Nepali.
home.phaseNote: Early build: models are trained on synthetic data and avatar motion is procedural. Accuracy and sign fidelity improve once real NSL data and authored clips are added — the pipeline runs end-to-end today.

score.title: Movement scoring (DTW)
score.note: Real DTW on joint angles vs. the sign's reference, decomposed per parameter. Uses a synthesized attempt (a slider stands in for the webcam); references are synthetic until real signs are collected.
